notes: All crash occurred in bright afternoon daylight (16:36:12.7 EDT, May 7, 2016, sun azimuth 265 deg, elevation 45.1 deg); therefore no night-time lighting pass is needed and all 3D shots use the accurate daylight environment.

Shot S02 (aerial_dissolve) is marked optional:true because no satellite/aerial orthophoto is in the case file; its fallback dissolves directly from Exhibit 4 (evidence/map.png) into the registered 3D top-down view.
All dynamic vehicle playback runs at strict 1.0x real-time (slope = 1.0 in sceneTimeMap) between holds/freezes, matching the reference grammar rules.

All three witnesses (wit_B, wit_A, wit_C) have dedicated title cards and stationary eye-level shots with live sightline rays (colorClear #30d158, colorBlocked #ff3b30) and a 3.5-second hold at their exact observationTime (t = 9.9 s, t = 2.0 s, and t = 5.0 s respectively) before continuing to impact at t = 10.43 s.
